site.name: ourlegacy-revisit
site.site_hint: a website that turns family stories into illustrated keepsake storybooks
site.goal:
You are back on OurLegacy and still signed in. Open the storybook you made last time from My Storybooks.
Go on to the site's remaining step for it (the output / export step), personalise what it offers,
create the preview or PDF it offers and look carefully at everything that produces - every page and
every picture. Also try to fix what was wrong with your book using the site's own tools (for example
the options on each scene), and judge whether the site lets you make the changes you want. Give your
honest opinion of each part. Do not pay real money.
site.spend_rule: Your account still has free starter credits; you may spend those free credits (for example on a preview, a PDF or re-drawing a picture), but never enter payment details, buy credits or order a printed book.
